# Solution: Add ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket

Below are the new manifests for both environments. The bucket files include versioning, AES256 encryption, and public access blocking. The policy files grant the service principal `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` on the logs bucket only.

**Note:** Replace `myapp` in the `userName` and `roleName` fields with the actual name of your existing User and Role resources from your current `iam.yaml` files.

---

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: UserPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  userName: myapp  # Replace with actual User name from dev/iam.yaml
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  roleName: myapp  # Replace with actual Role name from prod/iam.yaml
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

## Deployment

Apply both environments independently:

```bash
kubectl apply -f dev/
kubectl apply -f prod/
```

The `UserPolicy` (dev) and `RolePolicy` (prod) resources will be created inline and attached to their respective service principals, scoped exclusively to the logs bucket. The assets bucket remains unaffected.
